about: Spoken radio lines for generated jobs (docs/remix-missions.md "Spoken lines"): our line text, where each may be said, and a numbers-only recipe of cuts of the player's own clips (game, clip stem, start/end samples at 11025 Hz, gain dB, fades, optional high-shelf tilt, WSOLA stretch, EQ match), rebuilt at run time. No audio and no game text here. Written by tools/remix-voice-table.py.
